integer_arithmetic.floats: forbidden in source telemetry, execution manifest, and metric artifact
integer_arithmetic.ceil_div: ceil_div(a,b)=(a+b-1)//b for nonnegative integer a and positive integer b
integer_arithmetic.reported_rates: Report integer numerator and denominator plus null when denominator is zero; decimal display is derived presentation only.

populations.attempt: One exact bounded lifecycle execution identified by attempt_id for one repository/PR/role. Failed and retried attempts remain separate attempts.
populations.pr_role_stream: All attempts for one exact repository/PR/role ordered by started_at, beginning at its first attempt and ending at successful artifact freeze or terminal allowed failure.
populations.stream_wall_milliseconds: completed_at of final stream attempt minus started_at of first stream attempt; includes retry gaps.
populations.stream_tokens_bytes_tools_cost: Integer sum across every attempt in the stream, including failed and retried attempts.
populations.successful_role_populations: Review A streams, Review B streams, and adjudication streams are reported separately; each expected denominator is 3.
populations.pooled_review_population: The six successful Review A and Review B streams only; adjudication is excluded.

quantiles.input: Successful stream values in the named role population, or all six successful review streams only when explicitly named pooled_review.
quantiles.median: Sort ascending; odd n selects rank (n+1)//2; even n reports numerator=sum of ranks n//2 and n//2+1 with denominator=2, without float coercion.
quantiles.p95: Sort ascending and select one-indexed nearest rank ceil_div(95*n,100).
quantiles.empty: Report null with numerator 0 and denominator 0.

failure_retry.all_attempt_count: Count every recorded attempt across all roles.
failure_retry.failed_attempt_count: Attempts whose explicit success disposition is false.
failure_retry.terminal_failed_stream_count: Required PR-role streams with no successful allowed attempt.
failure_retry.role_overhead_attempts_per_stream: For each role, total attempt count for that role divided by 3; retain numerator/denominator for projection ceiling.

agreement.claim_set: For each lane and PR, the set of exact (kind,public_id) for claims with recommendation include.
agreement.exact_set_match: Count PRs in positive_claim_population where A_claim_set equals B_claim_set; report numerator and positive population denominator.
agreement.per_pr_jaccard: For each PR in positive_claim_population, intersection_count=|A intersect B| and union_count=|A union B|; report each integer pair. For exact macro Jaccard let L be the least common multiple of all positive union_count values, macro_numerator=sum(intersection_count*(L//union_count)), and macro_denominator=L*positive_population_count; reduce by gcd. Presentation may derive a decimal from this exact rational but must not average rounded values.
agreement.zero_union: Exclude zero-union PRs from Jaccard and exact-set-match positive population; report zero_union_count separately. Never coerce zero union to 1.
agreement.both_empty_agreement: Count PRs where both exact include claim sets are empty divided by all 3 pilot PRs.
agreement.terminal_status_agreement: Exact terminal_recommendation equality count divided by all 3 pilot PRs.
agreement.evaluability_agreement: Equality of the boolean terminal_recommendation==not_evaluable divided by all 3 pilot PRs.
agreement.matching: No alias, suffix, spelling, wildcard, or semantic normalization.

projection_2500.scope: Operational non-statistical conservative projection with Review A, Review B, and terminal adjudication for every PR.
projection_2500.role_streams: For each role exactly 2500 projected PR-role streams.
projection_2500.role_attempts: ceil_div(2500*observed_role_attempt_count,3); total projected attempts is the sum across roles.
projection_2500.role_tokens: ceil_div(2500*sum observed stream total tokens for role,3); sum roles for total.
projection_2500.role_bytes: ceil_div(2500*sum observed stream input_bytes+output_bytes for role,3); sum roles for total.
projection_2500.role_serial_wall_milliseconds: ceil_div(2500*sum observed stream wall_milliseconds for role,3); sum roles for total.
projection_2500.role_parallel_wall_milliseconds: ceil_div(2500,approved_role_concurrency)*observed role p95 stream wall_milliseconds; roles execute sequentially in A then B then adjudication phases for conservative total, so sum roles.
projection_2500.role_cost_micro_usd: ceil_div(2500*sum observed stream cost_micro_usd for role,3); sum roles for total.
projection_2500.rounding: Apply ceil_div once per role formula exactly as written, then integer-sum roles; do not round per token, byte, millisecond, or PR first.

resource_and_concurrency.host_inputs: Execution manifest freezes available_ram_bytes, idle_supervisor_rss_bytes, provider_concurrency_cap, disk_free_bytes, immutable_cache_bytes, and policy role caps before pilot.
resource_and_concurrency.role_peak_rss: Nearest-rank p95 of mandatory sampled_peak_process_tree_rss_bytes across all attempts for that role; it must be a positive integer, and zero or missing is no_go with no concurrency approval.
resource_and_concurrency.role_scratch_disk: Maximum of 0 and disk_bytes_after-disk_bytes_before across all attempts for that role.
resource_and_concurrency.memory_cap: When role_peak_rss is positive, floor((available_ram_bytes*70//100-idle_supervisor_rss_bytes)/role_peak_rss), with nonpositive numerator forcing 0; role_peak_rss zero or missing is no_go and memory_cap is null, never divided.
resource_and_concurrency.approved_role_concurrency: max(1,min(policy_role_cap,provider_concurrency_cap,memory_cap)) only when memory_cap>=1 and every mandatory measurement exists; otherwise no_go and no concurrency approval.
resource_and_concurrency.projected_peak_ram_bytes: idle_supervisor_rss_bytes + approved_role_concurrency*role_peak_rss, reported per role and maximum across sequential roles.
resource_and_concurrency.projected_disk_bytes: immutable_cache_bytes + max over roles(approved_role_concurrency*role_scratch_disk) + ceil_div(2500*sum observed successful stream artifact+transcript+telemetry bytes across all roles,3).
resource_and_concurrency.disk_gate: projected_disk_bytes must not exceed disk_free_bytes*70//100 and the frozen policy disk bound.
resource_and_concurrency.assumptions: No shared-memory savings, phase overlap, cache compression, or provider batching is credited. All projections are operational and non-statistical.

approval_boundary.pre_pilot_budget: Execution manifest freezes integer budget_micro_usd and explicit approval for only three PRs before any attempt.
approval_boundary.post_pilot_scale: Projected 2500-PR integer micro-USD spend, duration, tokens, bytes, concurrency, RAM, and disk require separate explicit supervisor approval; pre-pilot approval cannot authorize scale execution.
